content.short: Capa automates real-time pay-ins and pay-outs across Latin America with same-day settlement.
content.description: Capa runs a 24-hour FX and payment platform connecting Latin America to the rest of the world, reachable by API, SDK or dashboard. Businesses automate pay-ins and pay-outs through it with same-day settlement. Customers report FX fee savings of 87 to 91 percent against their previous arrangements, and Borderless.xyz uses it for cross-border routing. Settlement currencies span USDC, USDT, EUR and local currencies including the Dominican peso.
content.meta: Capa is a 24-hour FX and payments platform automating pay-ins and pay-outs between Latin America and the world, with same-day settlement.
